test_title: PYST 19: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26f1fdb230b0084c2d45d3baeade7bdbebbb81394cfcb3ea1349327a19df8540.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +2.

Let's check each option:

1. RV – OX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ffc8c3cad9adb7e7fee6ff23be2659cd8e72d231f4bf2176a0f717b92c0c853.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3 +2.

 

2. NR – PT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dded796c0eeb32df2b5e0dc68abf9e9a0976137f3b28500aab72e4b62675624.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -3 +2.

3. MQ – JS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f5b6813c15852ee69b5e175577132dd6873834ac578f74b28962c764c98c84e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3 +2.

4. UY – RA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9ab02360e366760080a87fde0c02f835f5f4ec06bf9d0335d8fd5cd040ef495.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3 +2.

Thus, NR – PT is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
